hypotheses.capacity_assumption: Top-5 depth and public trades are 15-minute aggregates; no executable capacity is claimed until candidate-bound L2 replay passes.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: Reject if either development segment has non-positive net annualized return, the explicit-cost edge is non-positive, or any campaign statistical gate fails.
hypotheses.hypothesis: When top-five displayed liquidity and aggressive trade flow point in the same direction relative to their prior four-hour distributions, that pressure continues for one additional 15-minute bar after explicit costs.
hypotheses.rationale: A synchronized book imbalance and taker imbalance may identify information-driven demand before passive liquidity fully replenishes.

hypotheses.capacity_assumption: Open-interest change is a normalized 15-minute aggregate and trade flow is public taker flow; no leverage or size claim is made from this development result.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: Reject if flow accompanied by position creation does not produce positive net next-bar returns in both train and valid, or if stability and multiple-testing gates fail.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Aggressive trade flow has more persistent 15-minute directional impact when it coincides with same-direction open-interest expansion, indicating new position formation rather than position transfer.
hypotheses.mechanism: Aggressive flow confirmed by position creation
hypotheses.rationale: Combining taker direction with open-interest change distinguishes new risk deployment from trades that merely exchange existing inventory.

hypotheses.capacity_assumption: Basis is mark price minus contemporaneous order-book mid in basis points; no spot hedge, funding carry, or cross-venue capacity is modeled in this directional development test.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: Reject if extreme mark-to-mid basis does not mean-revert enough over the next 15 minutes to overcome 7.5 bps modeled cost in both development segments.
hypotheses.hypothesis: An extreme mark-to-mid basis relative to the prior day reverses over the next 15-minute bar as temporary derivative pricing pressure dissipates.
hypotheses.rationale: The mark-to-mid deviation measures a positioning and pricing dislocation that is economically distinct from candle-only momentum or reversal.
